units.characteristics: the divine evaluative operation; naming; the living kinds
units.gist: NARRATIVE - creation days; the recurring appraisal 'God saw that it was GOOD' (a single evaluative process across the days); naming (call); blessing/multiply of the living kinds

units.characteristics: image; blessing; dominion; multiply; food-gift; very-good; consecrated rest
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the human vocation web: made in God's IMAGE, blessed, given DOMINION and multiply, the food-GIFT, the climactic 'VERY good', and the consecrated sabbath REST that closes the appraisal

units.characteristics: breath-life; the two trees (knowledge/desire); work-and-keep; one-flesh; naked-unashamed
units.gist: NARRATIVE - man formed, God's BREATH making a living SOUL; the tree of KNOWLEDGE (desire/pleasant); to SERVE and KEEP; naming the animals; the woman, FLESH of my flesh / one flesh; naked and NOT ASHAMED (the hinge into ch 3)

units.characteristics: temptation; appraisal/desire; act; exposure; hiding; blame
units.gist: NARRATIVE (worked example) - the CRAFTY serpent; the woman's appraisal (saw GOOD / DELIGHT / DESIRED to make wise) and the act; eyes opened, they KNEW nakedness; HEARD God and HID; AFRAID; 'the woman you GAVE me' (give-as-blame). knowing inverts; gift becomes alibi

units.characteristics: the sentence and its inner-being content; hope amid judgment; expulsion
units.gist: NARRATIVE - curse; ENMITY (3:15); the woman's DESIRE-and-RULE and TOIL (3:16); the ground CURSED, toil (3:17-19); Eve named 'mother of all LIVING' (hope amid judgment, 3:20); lest he eat and LIVE forever - expulsion and the GUARDED tree of life

units.characteristics: envy/anger; the interior diagnosis (sin's desire, you must rule); murder; guilt
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Cain INCENSED, face FALLEN (4:5-6); the diagnosis 'sin is crouching, its DESIRE is for you, but you must RULE over it' (4:7); the murder; the ground CURSED; 'my punishment/iniquity is too great' (4:13); the mark

units.characteristics: Lamech's vengeance-boast vs the beginning of calling on the Name
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Cain's line; LAMECH's escalated vengeance-song ('HEAR my voice... I have killed... seventy-sevenfold', 4:23-24) set against the opposite interior operation - Seth, and 'then began men to CALL ON THE NAME of the LORD' (4:26)

units.characteristics: the death-formula (repeated mortality) broken by Enoch and by Noah's naming
units.gist: NARRATIVE/genealogy - the repeated 'and he LIVED... and he DIED' formula (the reign of mortality, same operation recurring) broken TWICE: Enoch 'walked with God, and was NOT, for God TOOK him' (5:22-24), and Noah named for COMFORT/relief from the cursed ground (5:29). the gem = the difference between identical 'to live' spans

units.characteristics: the human heart only-evil; the divine heart grieved; favour
units.gist: NARRATIVE - every INTENTION/PLOT of the thoughts of the HEART only evil continually (6:5); the LORD SORRY/RELENTED and GRIEVED to his HEART (6:6-7); but Noah found FAVOUR (6:8). a two-sided heart-web (human + divine interior)

units.characteristics: righteous/blameless Noah walking with God; the earth ruined; covenant; obedience; the flood
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Noah RIGHTEOUS and BLAMELESS, walked with God (6:9); the earth RUINED/corrupt (6:11-13); COVENANT established (6:18); Noah's OBEDIENCE ('did all as commanded'); clean/PURE distinction (7:2,8); the flood prevails

units.characteristics: God remembered Noah; the aroma; the resolve despite the heart's evil
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'God REMEMBERED Noah' (8:1); the WAITING (8:10-12); the altar and SOOTHING/pleasing aroma; the LORD's resolve 'never again... though the INTENTION of man's HEART is evil from his youth' (8:21) - pairs with GEN-09 (same heart, now met with mercy not grief-unto-destruction)

units.characteristics: blessing/multiply; dread on the animals; lifeblood/image; the covenant and rainbow
units.gist: NARRATIVE - BLESS and multiply (9:1,7); the FEAR/TERROR given to the animals (9:2); lifeblood / SOUL-life and the IMAGE as ground of the murder-prohibition (9:4-6); the COVENANT + rainbow + 'I will REMEMBER' (9:9-17)

units.characteristics: the interior of shame; the curse/bless operation
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Noah's drunkenness and nakedness; Ham's act, and what the sons KNEW/did not see (9:24); the CURSE of Canaan and the BLESSING of Shem (9:25-26)

units.characteristics: self-exaltation (make a name) and the scattering/confusion
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'let us make a NAME for ourselves, lest we be scattered' (self-securing self-exaltation); the LORD sees their PLAN (11:6) and confuses their UNDERSTANDING/language (11:7); the name Babel (11:9) - the pride-and-scattering web

units.characteristics: the mortality-formula COMPRESSED post-flood (distinct from Gen 5, not a repeat)
units.gist: GENEALOGY - the Shemite 'and he LIVED... and had sons' formula (11:10-26). NOT a repeat of the Gen 5 formula: here the lifespans COMPRESS sharply post-flood (Shem 600 -> Peleg/Reu ~200s), the shadow of death tightening over the lineage that runs to Abram. the distinction from GEN-08 is the finding; do not merge
